title: fix(codemod-split-engine): R10 keeps a module's other ./engine.js names; R4 passes a name a routed module already imports
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9AN5TcsoztpjS9TKU19Wvqu)_

Refs #30020

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：只改搬移工具 `scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs`：R10（把模块切到静态成员转发路线）改道时保留模块 `./engine.js` 导入行上已有的其他名字；R4 遇到路线上模块已经导入的名字时不再拒绝、也不再重复导入。附 3 个自测用例。
- **为什么改**：#30020 E5 要搬 `ObjectQL#insert`，其目标模块 `engine-insert.ts` 的 `./engine.js` 行还带着 `InsertManyRowOutcome`，原工具因此拒绝搬。E5 的搬移 PR #31922 超过 3000 行人工合并线，席位裁定先把工具改动单独落地。
- **风险与回滚**：只影响开发期工具，不进任何发布包（skip-changeset）。undo 证明仍逐字节；4 个消融各自变红后还原。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`engineRunOf` / `rerouteModule` / `unrouteModule`，以及 `planMembers` 和 `moduleImportEdits` 里 R4 的 held-name 分支。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --self-test`（232 cases / 14 batteries pass），再 `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --members insert`（dry run，打印 byte-for-byte 的 undo proof）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **R10 reads the whole `./engine.js` run.** On `main`, R10 rerouted only a module whose `./engine.js` import was exactly `import type { ObjectQL } from './engine.js';`. `engine-insert.ts` carries `import type { InsertManyRowOutcome, ObjectQL } from './engine.js';`, so `--members insert` refused. R10 now reads the run (`engineRunOf`) and requires `importPair`'s form: the class type-only, every other name plain. It writes the statics pair in the class's place beside the same names. The undo (`unrouteModule`) writes them back.
- **R4 into a routed module passes an already-imported name.** A name `engine.ts` exports and a routed module already imports in a form that serves the read needs no edit, so `moduleImportEdits` skips it. A name the module does not import still refuses.

## Tests

- 3 new cases in the battery `statics route for a written module (fourth pass, #30020 R10)` (floor 18 → 21): reroute keeps other names; R10 undoes it byte-for-byte; R4 of an already-imported name needs no edit.
- 2 existing cases re-aimed at shapes that still refuse: a value-imported `ObjectQLClass`, and a hand-spaced import.
- Self-test: 229 → 232 cases / 14 batteries.

| Ablation (via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each red, then restored: blob == HEAD) | Red cases |
|:--|:--|
| R4 held-name pass off in `planMembers` | 1 |
| held-name skip off in `moduleImportEdits` | 1 |
| R10 refuses a run with other names | 3 |
| R10 first-pass-form check off | 1 |

The same diff, measured inside #31922 (head 5b489a9e), gave an undo proof that is byte-exact for the `insert` move and 120/120 derived gates.

## Verification on this branch

Head `f8023a44` (one commit, the patch applied to `main` `6a8f4151` with a clean `git apply --check`), `scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` only, +73 / −18.

| Run | Result |
|:--|:--|
| `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --self-test` | exit 0, 232 cases in 14 batteries pass |
| `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --members insert` (dry run) | exit 0; undo proof: undoing the `insert` move rebuilds the base `engine.ts` and its modules byte-for-byte (13 bindings only the moved body reads pruned); nothing written |
| the same dry run on `main` without this change | exit 2: `engine-insert.ts: its ./engine.js import is not the one import type { ObjectQL } from './engine.js'; … this pass reroutes only that shape` |
| `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, each run, then `--ran` | 28 derived, 28 run, every exit 0; 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN |

No changeset: a repo script, published nowhere (`skip-changeset`).
